annotations.title: Grahan and Gochar (eclipses and planetary transits)

description: Upcoming Surya and Chandra Grahan (solar and lunar eclipses) with type, start, peak and end times, whether visible at a place, the rashi and nakshatra of the eclipse, and sutak start time; plus today's graha sthiti (sidereal sign, degree, nakshatra, retrograde) and the gochar calendar — every rashi change (rashi parivartan) and vakri / margi station of the grahas for the coming months. Swiss Ephemeris, Lahiri ayanamsha, Trikaal Vaani gochar engine. Optionally pass the Moon sign (chandra_rashi) to get Shani Sade Sati / Dhaiya status and its periods. Default place New Delhi, times in the given timezone (India 5.5).

chandra_rashi.description: Optional Moon sign (Chandra rashi) for Sade Sati / Dhaiya

latitude.description: Place latitude for eclipse visibility (default New Delhi)

months.description: How many months ahead to list (1-24, default 12)

timezone.description: UTC offset in hours for the times shown (India = 5.5)
